title: NINLARO Capsules Drug Use-Results Survey (All-Case Surveillance) "Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma"
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety of NINLARO in participants with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma in daily clinical practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who have been confirmed as administration of the drug.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: The study population will consist of all participants with a diagnosis of multiple myeloma and received their first dose of NINLARO/lenalidomide, and dexamethasone.
